name: Organised Crime Extortion and Loan-Sharking
description: Coercive collection of 'protection' money or repayments on high-interest illegal loans by organised crime groups, usually from small businesses and vulnerable individuals. Victims often show regular payments that do not match any invoice or service, sometimes via third parties or cash.

sources.text: UN Convention against Transnational Organized Crime (2000)
UNODC, public material on organised crime and extortion
Europol, European Union Serious and Organised Crime Threat Assessment (EU SOCTA) (specify year, e.g. 2021 or 2025)

exposure.rationale: Regular unexplained payments and cash withdrawals by small businesses/vulnerable victims.
